workspacesDescription.message: A workspace contains all of its windows, groups and tabs.

appBackupDescription.message: Complete recovery backup of settings, workspaces and portable metadata.

appBackupCaveat.message: Firefox runtime IDs, window mappings, countdowns and snapshot locks are not backed up. Restore leaves open Firefox windows unchanged. An exact match reattaches existing windows automatically. Otherwise, workspaces remain inactive and session recovery warns before creating additional windows.

syncDescription.message: AUTO settings, hostname policies and URL exceptions are synchronized. Runtime tabs, countdowns, statistics and window snapshots remain local.

autoDescription.message: Settings are saved immediately. AUTO respects the configured timeout and protections.

urlExceptionsDescription.message: Exact URL exceptions take precedence over hostname policies. Use KEEP for pages that require persistent EventSource or WebSocket connections.

helpPrinciple.message: Workspace Manager maintains your browsing environment as a set of windows, groups and tabs. Tabs can remain loaded, automatically be discarded or be protected from unloading.

helpKeep.message: The hostname is protected and stays loaded.

helpAuto.message: The tab is discarded automatically after the configured inactivity timeout. Its countdown is shown next to the tab.

helpDeepAlways.message: Inactive tabs for this hostname should always be discarded. A watchdog checks this every 30 seconds.

helpExactExcept.message: An exact full URL can have a KEEP exception even if its hostname uses DEEP ALWAYS.

helpTabProtection.message: The active tab in each Firefox window, pinned tabs and tabs playing audio are protected according to settings.

helpPanels.message: Windows start collapsed. Search matches tab titles, URLs and group names; matching parts expand automatically. State and Policy filters can be combined.

helpWorkspace.message: A workspace is a saved collection of Firefox windows. Each window preserves its tab order and native tab groups.

helpSave.message: Saves the current active workspace immediately. In LIVE mode, it is also updated automatically.

helpSaveNew.message: Creates and activates a new workspace from the currently open Firefox windows, groups and tabs after verification.

helpImport.message: Imports one workspace. If its name exists, you must rename it or cancel the import.

helpBackupWs.message: Exports all saved workspaces into a single versioned JSON file.

helpRestoreWs.message: Imports workspaces from a backup without overwriting existing ones. Conflicting names must be renamed.

helpSwitch.message: Saves the current state, restores the target workspace and closes the current workspace's windows only after verifying the new ones.

helpRename.message: Only changes the user-defined workspace name.

helpDelete.message: Deletes the stored definition. If it was active, its open windows stay open and are adopted by a new workspace.

helpCloseWindow.message: Closing a window with X does not delete its workspace. Firefox does not expose whether the close was intentional, so the saved state is preserved.

helpPolicy.message: A hostname policy applies to the exact hostname or subdomain. An exact URL exception takes precedence.

helpSync.message: Firefox Sync is optional. It synchronizes AUTO settings, hostname policies and URL exceptions. Runtime IDs, countdowns, usage statistics and workspace snapshots stay local.

helpPopup.message: The popup is a compact dashboard showing the active workspace, numbers of windows, tabs and groups, loaded/discarded states and AUTO, KEEP, DEEP and EXCEPT counts.

helpStats.message: Hostname statistics track foreground and background time to help decide whether rarely used hosts should switch from AUTO to DEEP ALWAYS.

extensionDescription.message: Persistent Firefox workspaces with tab lifecycle management.

hostnameExample.message: A policy applies to the entire hostname, for example sub.example.com.

helpExpand.message: Expand all and Collapse all control the tree. Always expanded keeps all windows and groups open. Optional auto-refresh every 5, 10, 30 or 60 seconds preserves manual expansion state.

helpManualDeep.message: DEEP manually unloads a tab from memory while preserving its position, group and URL.

helpGroupDeep.message: DEEP group unloads eligible tabs in a group. DEEP ALL unloads all eligible tabs while respecting protections, KEEP and EXCEPT.

helpExceptAction.message: The EXCEPT action adds or removes a KEEP exception for the tab's exact current URL after confirmation.

helpAppBackup.message: Application backup exports workspaces, AUTO settings, hostname policies, URL exceptions, Sync preference, known hosts, statistics and stable UI preferences into one versioned JSON file. Runtime IDs are omitted.

helpAppRestore.message: Application restore replaces durable state from backup without closing open Firefox windows. A unique exact match reattaches live windows; changed or ambiguous sessions are not attached and recovery asks before creating possible duplicates.

helpDevWatcher.message: When running through web-ext, changes to runtime files reload the extension. An open manager tab at moz-extension:// may close. The installed release does not run this development watcher.
